Software Development Engineer II - Backend (Java)

About the team
Our payments platform processes millions of transactions a day. We are looking for an SDE-2 to design and build
backend services that are secure, observable and fast.

What you will do
- Design, build and own microservices in Java and Spring Boot that expose REST APIs to internal and partner teams.
- Model data in PostgreSQL, write efficient SQL and tune queries; use Redis for caching hot paths.
- Build event-driven flows with Kafka and make services resilient with retries and idempotency.
- Secure APIs with JWT and OAuth2 using Spring Security; work with role-based access control.
- Ship through CI/CD pipelines with Docker and Kubernetes on AWS.
- Write unit and integration tests with JUnit and Mockito; take part in code reviews and on-call.

Requirements
- 2-5 years of experience building backend services in Java.
- Strong knowledge of Spring Boot, Hibernate/JPA, microservices architecture and REST API design.
- Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL, Docker and Kubernetes.
- B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science or a related field.

Good to have
- Experience with Kafka, Redis, AWS and GraphQL.
- Exposure to system design for high-throughput distributed systems.
